reviews.reviewbody: This is an all time classic. Thank you to those who took the time to read it!

The quality of the narrators varies a lot.
One of the narrators is really slow.
I would not recommend this to anyone.
reviews.reviewtitle: Different Narrators - Some Good, Most Poor.

reviews.reviewtitle: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland Librivox Recordings
reviews.reviewbody: Although some of the tones of the readers' voices may vary, the love and enjoyment they have for this classic story cannot be denied. Makes for the perfect thing to listen to while relaxing in the afternoon or in bed.
A great book and a good recording
I have heard this audiobook, had a great experience, recommend you all to hear Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, by Lewis Carroll audiobook.

Its read flawlessly, i like the cover for it, very nice soft-like voice
Great for working, just put it in the background and lisen

reviews.reviewtitle: Alice's Adventures original is the best version
reviews.reviewbody: All the readings were smooth and engaging. Very good style to tell this story
